mapper.select: SELECT opr.payment_method AS payment_method, COALESCE(SUM(opr.payment_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_payment_records opr ON o.order_id = opr.order_id WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId} AND o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time < #{endTime} AND o.payment_status = 2 AND o.deleted = 0 AND opr.deleted = 0 GROUP BY opr.payment_method ORDER BY opr.payment_method
